tools.name: check_room_availability
tools.description: Check a selected room’s current rate and availability for guest-confirmed arrival, nights and occupancy. Rates may be cached for 120 seconds. No booking or hold. Never infer missing guest choices.

room.description: Guest-selected room ID. Get room names and capacity using get_hotel_info.

checkIn.description: Arrival YYYY-MM-DD in America/Los_Angeles; ask if ambiguous, especially after midnight.

adults.description: Guest-confirmed adult count; also subject to the selected room limit.

children.description: Guest-confirmed child count; do not silently assume zero.

tools.name: get_hotel_info
tools.description: Get public Dynasty Suites Redlands facts or room IDs and capacity limits. No personal, administrative or reservation data. Use check_in for arrival policies.

tools.name: prepare_booking_link
tools.description: Prepare, but do not open, a Direct Book link with the guest-selected room, dates and occupancy. Does not check availability, reserve, hold, charge or confirm anything. Guest completes booking in Direct Book.

room.description: Guest-selected room ID. Get room names and capacity using get_hotel_info.

checkIn.description: Arrival YYYY-MM-DD in America/Los_Angeles; ask if ambiguous, especially after midnight.

adults.description: Guest-confirmed adult count; also subject to the selected room limit.

children.description: Guest-confirmed child count; do not silently assume zero.
